Test move declaration refactoring: extracting declarations to the destination file.

-- capabilities.json --
{
	"experimental":{"interactiveResolve":{"inputTypes":["string"]}}
}

-- settings.json --
{
	"moveDeclaration": true
}

-- flags --
-ignore_extra_diags

-- go.mod --
module golang.org/lsptests/movedecledits

go 1.20

-- src/func.go --
package src

func Add(a, b int) int { //@codeaction(re"Add", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/dest/dest.go"}`, result=move_func)
	return a + b
}

-- src/type.go --
package src

type Point struct { //@codeaction(re"Point", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/dest/dest.go"}`, result=move_type)
	X int
	Y int
}

-- src/newfile.go --
package src

// Cross-package move to a new file: dest/newfile.go does not exist yet and must be created.
func Multiply(x, y int) int { //@codeaction(re"Multiply", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/dest/newfile.go"}`, result=move_new_file)
	return x * y
}

-- src/samepkg_new.go --
package src

// Same-package move to a new file: src/created.go does not exist yet and must be created.
func Separate() string { //@codeaction(re"Separate", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/src/created.go"}`, result=move_samepkg_new_file)
	return "same package new file"
}

//go:build go1.20

package src

func WithHeader() string { //@codeaction(re"WithHeader", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/src/header_created.go"}`, result=move_samepkg_header)
	return "header"
}


-- src/spec.go --
package src

type (
	First int
	Second string //@codeaction(re"Second", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/dest/dest.go"}`, result=move_subset_spec)
)

-- src/counter.go --
package src

type Counter struct { //@codeaction(re"Counter", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/dest/dest.go"}`, result=move_decl_with_method)
	Count int
}

func (c *Counter) Inc() {
	c.Count++
}

-- src/iota.go --
package src

const (
	Zero = iota
	One
	Two
)

-- src/helper.go --
package src

func HelperForTest() int { //@codeaction(re"HelperForTest", "refactor.move.moveDeclaration", answers=`{"file":"file://$WORKDIR/src/helper_test.go"}`, result=move_to_test_file)
	return 42
}

-- src/helper_test.go --
package src

import "testing"

func TestExisting(t *testing.T) {}

-- dest/dest.go --
package dest

func Existing() {}

	return 42
}
